about_the_game:
Pick A Side - Dinosaurs or Survivors

Dinosaurs

  • First-Person

  • Track

  • Chase

  • Kill

Survivors

  • Third-Person

  • Run

  • Compete Objectives 

  • Escape

Key Features

Asymmetrical 2v6 Multiplayer
Two dinosaurs against six humans. No rules, no fairness — just raw instinct and survival.

Procedurally Generated Maps
Every game features a new map layout with randomised Objectives locations and hiding spots. No two matches play the same.

True Player-Driven Horror
No scripted scares. Every moment is shaped by real players — their choices, their fears, and their instincts.

Photosensitivity Warning

This game contains flashing lights and visual effects that may trigger seizures for players with photosensitive epilepsy. Discontinue if you experience dizziness or discomfort. Play in a well-lit room and take regular breaks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Operating System
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce GTX 460 1GB or AMD HD 6850 1GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: With these requirements, it is recommended that the game is played on Low quality settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Operating System
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8300 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce 760 or AMD HD 8800 or higher with 4GB of RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible

short_description: 6 determined Survivors face two bloodthirsty Dinosaur's in a classic game of hide and seek. Pick a side and run, hide, and survive with Dynamic maps, intense chases, and pure player-driven horror. Can you survive the hunt?
